decisions.reason: The current FAQ state does not mention the Aave connector or yield generation, so removing those topics from the About page requires no FAQ state change.
Removing the Aave connector does not change the Harbor Quill or ArchiveLedger product names.
The automatic wallet-transfer prize flow remains valid independently of whether prize-pool funds use an Aave connector.
Removing the Aave connector does not alter ticket allocation for mints without referral codes.
Removing the Aave connector does not alter the amount, trigger, or recipient selection for no-referral commissions.
Chainlink VRF winner selection is independent of the removed Aave yield connector and remains unchanged.
Removing the Aave connector does not change deployment on the Base network.
The coded-referral commission amount, recipient, destination, and timing remain unchanged by removal of the Aave connector.
Removing the Aave connector has no necessary effect on the book, referral identity, badges, or prize-ticket state transferred with an NFT.
The NFT token serial and its display locations remain the referral identity regardless of the Aave connector removal.
The Transak fiat-mint provider, payment methods, and wallet-provisioning behavior are independent of the Aave connector.
Removing the Aave connector does not change unauthenticated access to leaderboard and pool-value APIs.
